component.subject: Call to Worship
component.source: Psalm 117, Open English Bible, release 2025.6, CC0, verbatim; the divine name printed "Lord".

original.p: Psalm 117 (OEB 2025.6): Praise the LORD, all you nations: laud him, all you peoples. For his mighty love is over us: the LORD is faithful forever. Hallelujah.

p.line: Praise the Lord, all you nations:
For his mighty love is over us:
